provenance.source: The model files shipped inside the rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4 wheel (PyPI, py3-none-any), rapidocr_onnxruntime/models/; ONNX conversions of PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 detection/recognition and the mobile v2.0 angle classifier
provenance.exposure: A generic Chinese/English scene-text recogniser; no plate-specific training is documented. Exposure to the benchmark images is not known.

note: Measuring instrument only (adequacy protocol §6); never a Stage-4 selection candidate. The angle classifier file is pinned because the engine loads it at construction; it is not used (useCls false).
